snippet.title: Dead Watch | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
You're stuck in a time loop ⌛. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing.

Play on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464670/Dead_Watch?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=harvestofterror"
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
